# OOMMF — Landau-Lifshitz Micromagnetic Simulator — LLM Search Index
# https://llmstxt.org/

> Discrete 2D/3D micromagnetic vector lattice simulation solving the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) differential equation for spintronic devices, magnetic vortices, and skyrmion lattice dynamics.

## Project Identification
- Name: OOMMF Micromagnetics (oommf)
- Creator & Lead Physicist: Jirnyak (https://github.com/Jirnyak)
- Co-Architect & Contributor: Adolf Petushkov (https://github.com/marko1olo)
- Live Simulation: https://jirnyak.github.io/oommf/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Jirnyak/oommf

## Physics Core
- Mathematical Model: Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation governing precessional motion and damping:
  dM/dt = -γ (M × H_eff) + (α/M_s) (M × dM/dt)
- Energy Terms: Exchange interaction (Heisenberg model), magnetocrystalline anisotropy, Zeeman external field, demagnetizing field.
